name: Low jack

phases.name: left out
phases.cue: Step your left foot out, arms sweeping overhead

phases.name: right out
phases.cue: Step your right foot out, arms sweeping overhead

formTips: Step wide to the side and land on the ball of the foot
Sweep your arms all the way overhead
Keep your knees soft and your core braced
Keep a steady rhythm, no jumping
commonMistakes: Only raising the arms to shoulder height
Leaning the body to the stepping side
